raw_text:
Below is a 12-week, low-impact, strength-focused program to rebuild lower-body capacity while protecting the knee, regain unilateral control, and rebuild total-body strength for a safe return to skiing. It’s organized into three 4-week phases with weekly progression, 3 days/week of primary strength sessions plus 1–2 optional GPP/conditioning sessions. All knee-dominant work respects “no deep knee flexion under load” (generally keep knee angle ≥70–80°) and avoids jumping/plyometrics. Emphasis is on tempo control, range management, and progressive loading without pain or swelling.

Key global guidelines
- Pain rule: 0–2/10 acceptable during exercise, no increase in swelling, and no symptom increase 24–48h after. If symptoms exceed this, reduce range, load, or volume by 20–40% and/or regress exercise.
- ROM management: Use box/bench heights or safety pins to limit squat/lunge depth; maintain shin relatively vertical; prioritize hip-dominant patterns.
- Tempo: Slow eccentrics (3–4s) early on, gradually normalizing to 2s as tolerance improves.
- Unilateral balance/rotation: Progress cautiously; start with supported, isometric, and anti-rotation work before dynamic frontal/transverse tasks.
- Conditioning: Low-impact modalities (bike, elliptical, sled push/pull, ski erg). No running or jumping.
- Warm-up (10–12 min each strength day):
  - 5 min easy bike
  - Mobility: ankle rocks (limited range), hip flexor + adductor mobilizations, T-spine openers (3x6–8 each)
  - Activation: mini-band lateral walks (2x10m), glute bridge iso (2x20–30s), terminal knee extension (TKE) band (2x12–15), bodyweight box squat to safe height (2x6)
- Cool-down: 5–8 min easy bike or walk, quad/hamstring/calf light stretching, patellar tendon soft-tissue work as tolerated.

Phase overview
- Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Restore patterns, build tolerance, controlled tempos, isometrics, ROM-limited knee work, bilateral base strength, unilateral stability. Introduce sled, cycling, core stiffness.
- Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Progressive strength, increase load, reduce tempo, introduce light accommodating resistance, add controlled eccentric/isometric exposures, increase unilateral loading and frontal-plane control. Begin ski-specific positions (tall-to-athletic stance transitions) without deep flexion.
- Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Strength emphasis with power preparation (no jumps), heavier hip-dominant lifts, split-stance strength, rotational control, higher-force sled work, on-snow posture conditioning (isometric wall sits at safe angles), and endurance of posture.

Weekly split
- Day A: Lower emphasis (hip-dominant + ROM-limited knee), core
- Day B: Upper emphasis + unilateral/knee accessories
- Day C: Total body strength (trap bar/hinge focus) + core rotation/anti-rotation
- Optional GPP/Cardio 1–2x/week: Low-impact conditioning and tissue capacity

Loading notes
- RPE: Start ~6–7 and build to 7–8. Avoid grinding; perfect form and pain-free ROM.
- Progression: When all sets completed at target RPE and pain/swelling stable, increase load 2.5–5% next week.

PHASE 1: Foundation, tolerance, control (Weeks 1–4)
Goals: Tissue tolerance, swelling control, motor control, build posterior-chain strength, establish unilateral stability without deep flexion.

Week 1
Day A
- Box Squat (high box; knee angle ~80–90°, 3-0-3 tempo): 3x6 @ RPE 6
- Romanian Deadlift (RDL): 3x8 @ RPE 6–7
- Sled Push (light, 15–20m): 4 passes, moderate pace (low knee bend)
- Split-Squat ISO (front foot elevated 2–3", hold mid-range): 3x20s/side
- Calf Raises (bilat, slow): 3x12
- Core: Side Plank: 3x25–30s/side

Day B
- Bench Press: 4x6 @ RPE 6–7
- Chest-Supported Row: 4x8
- Half-Kneeling Cable Anti-Rotation Press (Pallof): 3x10/side
- Step-Up to High Box (just tap and stand, no deep knee bend; use rail as needed): 3x6/side
- Hamstring Curl (machine): 3x10
- TKE (band): 2x15/side (light)

Day C
- Trap Bar Deadlift (high handles): 4x5 @ RPE 6–7
- Hip Thrust (pause 1s top): 3x8
- Reverse Lunge to High Box Touch (rear-foot light toe tap on box; shallow range): 3x6/side
- Seated Cable Row: 3x10
- Core: Dead Bug: 3x8/side; Bird Dog: 2x8/side

GPP (1–2x)
- Bike 20–30 min Z2; Sled Drag (backward) light 4x20m; gentle mobility

Week 2
- Progress load slightly if tolerance ok; reduce tempo on box squat to 3-0-2.
Day A
- Box Squat: 4x5 @ RPE 7
- RDL: 3x8 @ RPE 7
- Sled Push: 5x20m
- Split-Squat ISO: 3x25s/side
- Single-Leg Calf Raises: 3x10/side
- Side Plank with Row (cable): 3x8/side

Day B
- Incline DB Press: 4x8
- 1-Arm DB Row: 4x8/side
- Tall-Kneeling Anti-Rotation Hold: 3x20–25s
- Step-Up (same height): 3x7/side
- Hamstring Curl: 3x10–12
- TKE: 2x15

Day C
- Trap Bar DL (high): 4x5 @ RPE 7
- Hip Thrust: 4x8
- Reverse Lunge to Box Touch (shallow): 3x7/side
- Lat Pulldown: 3x10
- Core: Cable Chop (high-to-low): 3x10/side

Week 3
- If pain-free, very slightly lower box height 1 notch or keep same; ensure knee angle still not deep.
Day A
- Box Squat: 5x4 @ RPE 7–8
- RDL: 4x6–7 @ RPE 7
- Sled Push (moderate): 5x25m
- Split-Squat ISO: 3x30s/side
- Tibialis Raise (wall or machine): 3x15
- Copenhagen Side Plank (short lever): 2x15–20s/side

Day B
- Bench Press: 5x4 @ RPE 7–8
- Chest-Supported Row: 4x8 heavy
- Pallof Press (iso 2s each rep): 3x8/side
- Step-Up: 3x8/side (add light load)
- Hamstring Curl: 3x12
- TKE: 2x15–20

Day C
- Trap Bar DL: 5x3 @ RPE 7–8
- Hip Thrust: 4x6 @ RPE 7–8
- Supported B-Stance RDL (rear toe down): 3x8/side
- Landmine Press: 3x8/side
- Core: Dead Bug: 3x10/side

Week 4 (deload/assessment)
- Reduce volume ~30–40%, keep intensity moderate, keep ROM rules.
Day A
- Box Squat: 3x4 @ RPE 6–7
- RDL: 2x6
- Sled Push: 3x20m
- Split-Squat ISO: 2x20s/side
- Calf Raise: 2x10
- Side Plank: 2x20s

Day B
- Bench: 3x5 @ RPE 6–7
- Row: 3x8
- Pallof: 2x8/side
- Step-Up: 2x6/side
- Ham Curl: 2x10

Day C
- Trap Bar DL: 3x3 @ RPE 6–7
- Hip Thrust: 2x6
- B-Stance RDL: 2x8/side
- Core: light

PHASE 2: Strength building and unilateral progression (Weeks 5–8)
Goals: Increase absolute strength, introduce controlled isometrics/eccentrics under load, more split-stance work, frontal/transverse-plane stability. Maintain depth limits.

Week 5
Day A
- Safety Bar Box Squat (slightly lower if tolerated; 2s down): 5x3 @ RPE 7–8
- RDL: 4x6 @ RPE 7–8
- Sled Push (moderate-heavy): 6x20–25m
- Forward Step-Down (low box 4–6", slow 3s down, light support): 3x6/side
- Standing Calf Raise (heavy): 4x8
- Core: Side Plank with Hip Abduction (top leg): 3x8/side

Day B
- Weighted Pull-Up or Lat Pulldown: 4x6–8
- DB Bench Press: 4x8
- Cable Face Pull: 3x12
- Supported Split Squat (front foot elevated 2", mid-range): 3x8/side
- Hamstring Curl: 3x10–12
- TKE: 2x15–20

Day C
- Trap Bar Deadlift (high): 5x3 @ RPE 8
- Hip Thrust (1s pause): 4x6
- Lateral Sled Drag (handles at hip height): 4x15m/side
- Landmine Rotational Press (controlled, no twisting through knee): 3x6–8/side
- Core: Tall-Kneeling Anti-Rotation Press: 3x10/side

Week 6
Day A
- Safety Bar Box Squat: 6x2 @ RPE 8
- RDL: 4x5 heavy
- Sled Push: 6x25m heavier
- Step-Down: 3x7/side
- Seated Calf Raise: 4x10–12
- Copenhagen Plank (short to mid): 3x15–20s/side

Day B
- Bench Press: 5x3 @ RPE 8
- 1-Arm Cable Row: 4x8/side
- Face Pull: 3x12
- Supported Split Squat: 3x9/side (slight load up)
- Hamstring Curl: 3x12
- TKE: 2x15–20

Day C
- Trap Bar DL: 5x2 @ RPE 8–8.5
- Hip Thrust: 4x5
- B-Stance RDL: 3x8/side
- Landmine Press: 3x8/side
- Core: Cable Chop: 3x10/side

Week 7
Day A
- Safety Bar Box Squat: 5x3 @ RPE 8–8.5
- RDL (2s eccentric): 3x6
- Sled Push: 6x30m
- Step-Down: 3x8/side
- Standing Calf Raise: 4x8–10 heavy
- Side Plank with Row: 3x8/side

Day B
- Incline DB Press: 4x6–8
- Chest-Supported Row: 4x6–8 heavy
- Half-Kneeling Anti-Rotation ISO: 3x25–30s/side
- Split Squat (unsupported if tolerated, mid-range): 3x8/side
- Hamstring Curl: 3x10–12
- TKE: 2x15–20

Day C
- Trap Bar DL (cluster 1-1-1 with 20–30s rest): 4 clusters @ ~85% (RPE 8–8.5)
- Hip Thrust: 5x4 heavy
- Lateral Sled Drag: 4x20m/side
- Landmine Rotational Press: 3x6/side
- Core: Stir-the-Pot (on ball): 3x8–10 circles each direction

Week 8 (deload/assessment)
Day A
- Safety Bar Box Squat: 3x3 @ RPE 6–7
- RDL: 2x6
- Sled Push: 3x20m
- Step-Down: 2x6/side
- Calf: 2x10

Day B
- Bench: 3x4 @ RPE 6–7
- Row: 3x8
- Split Squat: 2x6/side light
- Ham Curl: 2x10
- Core light

Day C
- Trap Bar DL: 3x2 @ RPE 6–7
- Hip Thrust: 2x5
- Lateral Drag: 2x15m/side

PHASE 3: Max strength and ski-specific capacity (Weeks 9–12)
Goals: Higher-force outputs without deep knee flexion, unilateral/frontal-plane control, prolonged isometric endurance at ski-like angles, rotational stiffness, conditioning for long ski runs. Still no jumping.

Week 9
Day A
- Safety Bar Box Squat (box height you tolerate best): 5x2 @ RPE 8–9
- RDL: 4x4 heavy
- Sled Push Heavy: 6x25–30m
- Split Squat (mid-range, heavier): 4x6/side
- Wall Sit (knee angle not deep; ~70–80°, 30–45s): 3 holds
- Core: Offset Farmer Carry: 4x20–30m/side

Day B
- Weighted Pull-Up or Heavy Pulldown: 5x4–6
- Bench Press: 5x3 @ RPE 8–8.5
- Cable Row (neutral): 3x8
- Lateral Step-Through on Cable (anti-rotation, athletic stance): 3x6/side
- Hamstring Curl: 3x8–10
- TKE: 2x15–20

Day C
- Trap Bar Deadlift (heavy single practice, not max): Work to 3–4 singles @ RPE 8–8.5, then 1 back-off set 3x3 @ -10% load
- Hip Thrust: 4x4 heavy
- B-Stance RDL: 3x6/side
- Landmine Rotational Press: 3x6/side
- Core: Cable Anti-Rotation Press: 3x8/side

Week 10
Day A
- Safety Bar Box Squat: 6x2 @ RPE 8.5
- RDL (2s down): 4x5
- Sled Push (very heavy, short): 8x15–20m
- Split Squat: 4x6–7/side
- Wall Sit: 3x40–50s
- Farmers Carry (double): 4x30–40m

Day B
- Incline DB Press: 4x6
- Chest-Supported Row: 4x6 heavy
- Face Pull: 3x12
- Lateral Lunge to Box (shallow, to box surface, no deep flexion): 3x6/side
- Ham Curl: 3x10
- TKE: 2x15–20

Day C
- Trap Bar DL: 5x2 @ RPE 8.5–9
- Hip Thrust: 5x3 heavy
- Lateral Sled Drag (heavier): 5x20m/side
- Landmine Press: 3x6–8/side
- Core: Stir-the-Pot: 3x10–12 each direction

Week 11
Day A
- Safety Bar Box Squat: 5x2 @ RPE 8.5–9 (match or +2.5–5% from W9)
- RDL: 3x4 heavy
- Sled Push: 6x30m
- Split Squat (heavier): 4x5/side
- Wall Sit: 3x50–60s
- Offset Carry: 4x30m/side

Day B
- Bench Press: 5x2–3 @ RPE 8.5
- Weighted Pull-Up: 5x3–5
- Seated Cable Row: 3x8
- Lateral Lunge to Box: 3x6–7/side
- Ham Curl: 3x8–10
- TKE: 2x15–20

Day C
- Trap Bar DL (cluster 1-1-1 x 4 clusters at ~88–90%): RPE 8.5–9
- Hip Thrust: 4x3 heavy
- B-Stance RDL: 3x6/side
- Landmine Rotational Press: 3x6/side
- Core: Cable Chop: 3x8/side

Week 12 (taper/test and ski-prep capacity)
- Reduce total volume 30–40%, keep intensity moderate-high for first sessions, then taper.
Day A
- Safety Bar Box Squat: Work to comfortable heavy double @ RPE 8, then 2x2 @ -10%
- RDL: 2x4 moderate
- Sled Push: 4x20m
- Wall Sit: 2x45–60s
- Carry: 2x30m

Day B
- Bench: Work to heavy double @ RPE 8, back-off 2x2
- Pull-Up/Pulldown: 3x5–6
- Light lateral lunge patterning: 2x6/side
- Ham Curl: 2x8
- Core light

Day C
- Trap Bar DL: Work to 2–3 singles @ RPE 8, back-off 1x3 @ -10%
- Hip Thrust: 2x3 moderate
- Lateral Drag: 3x15m/side
- Core: easy anti-rotation

Optional GPP/Conditioning (1–2x weekly throughout)
- Weeks 1–4: Bike or elliptical 25–35 min Z2; backward sled drag light 4x20m; mobility
- Weeks 5–8: Bike intervals 6x2 min Z3 with 2 min Z1 between; SkiErg 3x6 min Z2; lateral band walks 2x10m
- Weeks 9–12: Mixed erg 35–45 min Z2; heavy sled push/drag circuit 5–6 rounds of 20m push + 20m backward drag with 90s rest; isometric wall sit sets (as above). Keep pain/swelling rules.

Ski-specific considerations and prep elements
- Posture endurance: Wall sits at safe angles progress from 30s to 60s holds; add med-ball hold (no twisting through knees).
- Frontal-plane control: Lateral sled drags, lateral lunges to box (shallow), Copenhagen planks.
- Rotational stiffness: Pallof presses, chops, landmine presses. Avoid twisting through the knee—load rotation through hips/torso.
- Eccentric control: Step-downs (slow) maintain integrity without deep flexion.
- Equipment tweaks: Heeled lifters or small heel wedge can reduce knee flexion demand during squats; safety bar keeps torso upright. Trap bar centralizes load.

Recovery and monitoring
- Frequency: 3 strength days + 1–2 GPP days; 1 full rest day minimum.
- Sleep: 7–9 hours; manage total daily steps to avoid large spikes on leg days.
- Swelling check: Morning circumference or subjective fullness. If increased, cut next session’s knee-dominant volume by ~30% and emphasize hips.
- Soft tissue: 5–10 min quad/ham/calf work post-session; patellar tendon glides as tolerated.
- Mobility: Daily 5–8 min hips/ankles/T-spine; avoid aggressive knee flexion stretching.
- Progress markers: Box squat and trap bar loads, step-down control (depth, tempo), wall sit duration with no symptom flare, sled load/distance.
- Return-to-snow bridge (post-week 12): Begin low-angle carving drills on dryland with slide board (shallow range), progress to on-snow greens with conservative volume when cleared for impact. Add low-amplitude pogo/landing prep only when surgeon/PT clears jumping.

Notes for day-to-day coaching
- Use box height/pins so the tibia stays near-vertical; prioritize hip hinge over knee bend in early phases.
- Cue “load the hips, keep knee tracking over second toe, smooth tempo.”
- Progress step-down height only if pain-free and no swelling increase next day.
- Favor trap bar over barbell back squat; safety bar + box is main squat pattern.
- If any exercise provokes more than 2/10 pain or lingering soreness at joint line, stop and regress (reduce ROM, lighten load, add support).

This plan builds total-body strength while systematically increasing knee tolerance, frontal-plane stability, and posture endurance needed for skiing—without violating the no-jump, no-deep-knee-flexion constraints.
